URL: https://abcnews.com/International/wireStory/gunmen-attack-community-northwestern-nigeria-kill-30-people-135122160
(AP wire carried by ABC News; fetched 28 July 2026)

Gunmen attack a community in northwestern Nigeria and kill 30 people, residents say (AP)

- At least 30 killed, several injured.
- Location: Naridon village, Kaura council area, Kaduna state, northwestern Nigeria.
- Timing: late Sunday night (27 July reporting).
- Attackers stormed the village around midnight, opened fire indiscriminately, burned homes and shops. Six children from a single family killed in one house.
- No specific group identified. Part of escalating violence across northern/central/western Nigeria (kidnapping for ransom, cattle rustling, extortion of farmers).

QUOTES:
- Raphael Joshua, resident assisting the injured: bodies of victims deposited at a nearby hospital, arrangements being made for burials.
- Derek Christopher, chairman, Southern Kaduna Peace and Security Network: "The same community was attacked last year around this time."
